Corollary
[pinching family from two-nonnegative curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0143, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0144 ↗ prop:chow-ii-preserved-stretched-two-nonnegative-cones ↗ thm:chow-ii-pinching-family-nonnegative-curvature 1. ch11:11.52\group Ricci Flow Pinching There is a pinching family whose initial cone is $\mathcal C$, the cone of two-nonnegative algebraic curvature operators.
Proof

\sketch Let $\bar b$ be as in 2 and intersect every cone of the family in 3 with $\ell _{a(\bar b),\bar b}(\mathcal C)$. This remains a pinching family and begins at the latter cone. Concatenate it with the preserved transverse family $\ell _{a(b),b}(\mathcal C)$, $0\le b\le \bar b$.

□
